purpose: Preview references for a future Design Projects redesign

concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, realistic, flat desktop website UI screenshot, landscape approximately 1600 by 1000. This is an implementable portfolio design reference. Existing visual system: warm pale beige #eeede8 background, charcoal #252621 typography, strong editorial sans serif headings, small monospace metadata, very minimal styling. The four input images are supporting poster artwork for insertion into the website layout, NOT the UI layout to copy. Image 1 is the BLANC white rose poster, image 2 the cream Midsommar poster, image 3 the blue/orange Ruins poster, image 4 the yellow/turquoise Bauhaus poster. Reproduce their complete compositions faithfully as artwork; keep original portrait proportions. Surrounding UI must be very clean and flat, preserve sharp square poster corners, quiet almost imperceptible paper shadows, no black card borders, no rounded artwork corners, no noisy additional textures, no tape, no pushpins, no fake wall photograph, no perspective device mockup, no huge 3D shadows. This should look like a thoughtful frontend designer's real portfolio and be consistent with an advertisement-sign-inspired previous section. Small top-left label exactly "DESIGN / SELECTED WORK", bold left-aligned heading exactly "Printed matter." with tight tracking. Small simple filters at upper right exactly "Posters", "Composites", "Interfaces"; Posters active with understated underline. Bottom-center floating rounded rectangular navbar in pale frosted beige, five fine charcoal outline icons: home, person, code, image, mail; image icon active in a solid charcoal square. Do not invent project logos or dates. Captions may only use "01 / BLANC", "02 / MIDSOMMAR", "03 / THE RUINS", "04 / BAUHAUS". No browser chrome, no annotations about how to implement it, no descriptive paragraphs. Composition A: a staggered street-poster wall expressed as a clean responsive website. A large featured BLANC poster on the left, its full sheet about 370px wide and 525px tall. Three medium sheets arranged to the right at differing vertical offsets: Midsommar about 265px wide, The Ruins about 265px wide, Bauhaus about 315px wide. Asymmetric but disciplined composition with 16 to 28px clear beige gaps, no overlap, top edges staggered by 35 to 85px. Artwork occupies most of the visible gallery, header occupies top 160px. Small numbered captions tucked directly under each sheet. Muted artwork overall, Bauhaus slightly more colorful to indicate hover. Include a subtle translucent horizontal sweep just halfway across the Bauhaus sheet, with a small arrow at its lower-right corner, unobtrusive. Spacious editorial balance, gallery almost full width with about 55px outer margins. This is the strongest recommended main gallery direction.

Stable gallery region that could replace the poster wall without changing outer container dimensions. Extremely restrained and readable.
